name: Command Center
summary: In Stormwind's Old Town, the Command Center trains recruits while most of the army serves abroad. Also called the Stormwind Barracks, it houses the city's military officers and a seasoned skeleton crew focused on drilling recruits and local militia.

sections.title: A Thin Line of Defense
sections.body: In Old Town, Stormwind's Command Center is a garrison and training ground for the kingdom's soldiers. Its halls are quieter than usual, with much of the royal army committed to campaigns abroad. Veteran instructors, including Ander Germaine and martial artist Wu Shen, train fresh warriors to strengthen the city's defenses.

sections.title: Old Town's Martial Hub
sections.body: When you ask for instruction in heavy arms or tactical combat, Stormwind's guards may point you to the Barracks. The building sits near the Pig and Whistle Tavern and the shadowy operations elsewhere in Old Town. It helps keep order in a district known for tavern brawls and roguish activity.

faq.q: Why is the Command Center so empty?
faq.answer: Most of Stormwind's standing army has been sent to distant outposts and foreign battlefields across the world. A seasoned skeleton crew remains to instruct recruits and organize local defense.

faq.q: Is the Command Center the same as the Stormwind Barracks?
aliases: are command center and barracks the same
faq.answer: Yes. The building is officially called the Command Center, though city guards and local residents often call it the Stormwind Barracks when giving directions.
Ander Germaine coordinates and trains Stormwind's warriors, alongside instructors such as Wu Shen and Ilsa Corbin.

faq.q: Where is the Command Center located?
faq.answer: You find the Command Center in Old Town, near the Pig and Whistle Tavern and the district's training facilities.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can train at Stormwind's Command Center, where veterans such as Ander Germaine and Wu Shen teach recruits to fight as disciplined frontline soldiers.
